title: Preflight UI Rollout Checklist — Console & Tooling — 2026-05-05
content:
Purpose:
Quick, pragmatic preflight for the upcoming console UI rollout (feature flags + analytics changes). This is a working checklist — aim is to catch anything that would cause user-facing regressions or blindspots in metrics/alerts.

Context:
- Target rollout window: 2026-05-07 22:00–23:00 UTC (low traffic, APAC overlap noted).
- Primary change: new routing inspector panel + revamped rollout controls (canary weight slider, auto-fallback toggle).
- Backend dependency: lightweight API extension to /rollouts (RDW-2018). PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/784
- Risk profile: medium (changes to both UI surface and telemetry names).

Preflight checklist (owner in parens):
1) Feature flags & gating
   - Verify feature flag exists and default is OFF for orgs > trial (Marcus Lee).
   - Confirm double-check override for internal-test orgs (dev accounts) — list of test org ids in RDW-test (Tom Nguyen).
   - Ensure the API returns consistent schema when flag toggled (contract tests passing).

2) API contract & backward compatibility
   - Run contract test suite against staging/backends-stable (Rina Kaur).
   - Confirm /rollouts responses include new canary metadata but preserve old fields for downgrade path.
   - Add a short compatibility doc in the PR describing fallback semantics.

3) Telemetry, analytics, and dashboards
   - Mapping table of new events -> existing telemetry consumers (analytics, billing):
     * ui.rollout.view -> unchanged
     * ui.rollout.adjust_weight -> new event (include org_id, user_role, delta)
     * ui.rollout.autofallback_trigger -> new alertable event
   - Add events to event catalog and set tagging in Amplitude (Marcus Lee).
   - Update console rollout dashboard: add a small traffic-split heatmap and canary conversion funnel (Rina).
   - Validate that token-level latency breakdown still reports correctly after the new inspector panel loads (perf smoke tests).

4) Observability & alerts
   - Ensure canary degradation alert exists: if error rate for canary > baseline + 2x for 5m -> page (SRE).
   - Add a new SLO check for API tail latency (p99) for /rollouts endpoints (oncall runbook updated).
   - Tracing: make sure new UI flow has trace span name consistent with trace-query patterns (Tom).

5) Rollout/runbook steps & fallback
   - Canary plan: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows.
   - Auto-fallback: default OFF. If enabled, must be documented and visible in UI with reason codes.
   - Rollback playbook: immediate global rollback command + manual audit step. Insert command snippets in runbook (Aisha).

6) QA matrix (manual + automated)
   - Manual smoke: open rollout inspector, change canary weight, verify UI reflects backend state, verify event emission (QA ticket RDW-QA-489).
   - Cross-org checks: admin vs non-admin role UX differences.
   - Keyboard navigation and screenreader spot checks for new elements (accessibility).
   - E2E tests: new Cypress flows added and passing on CI (PR linked).

7) Performance & resource checks
   - Measure first-paint and interactive times for the console route with inspector panel (baseline vs new). If mean interactive > baseline + 150ms, postpone (Marcus).
   - Memory snapshot on heavy org with many rollouts to ensure no leaked listeners.

8) Security & compliance
   - Confirm that audit logs include who changed rollout weights and why (GUID + user_id + timestamp).
   - Ensure no sensitive fields appear in analytics payloads (strip api_key/secret).

9) Customer communication
   - Draft short release note for Release Notes channel and customer-success FAQ (Aisha).
   - Prepare rollback FAQ for CS in case customers see unexpected behavior.

Open questions / risks:
- Analytics sampling: Are we sampling ui.rollout.adjust_weight events? If so, decide sampling rate before rollout (impacts RCA).
- Can the auto-fallback decision run into race with manual rollback? Need to define precedence.
- Big-org perf: we have only one perf sample from org "alpha-pay" in staging. Need one more in beta.

Day-of playbook snippet (short):
- 21:30 UTC: final smoke run from staging -> prod canary account (QA).
- 21:45 UTC: flip feature flag ON for internal orgs (dev) — verify telemetry.
- 22:00 UTC: start 1% canary; monitor SLI dashboard and traces in first 10m.
- 22:10 UTC: if ok, go 5% -> monitor 30m. If alert -> immediate rollback and notify #console-rollouts.
- Post-rollout: run quick grep of events to validate no high-frequency errors.

Notes & references:
- Slack thread: #console-rollouts (pinned messages include smoke test commands)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/784
- Linear: RDW-2018 (backend), RDW-2022 (instrumentation), RDW-QA-489 (QA ticket)

Immediate next actions (owner):
- Marcus: push Amplitude event definitions + perf snapshots (due 2026-05-06).
- Rina: update the rollout dashboard widgets + add heatmap (due 2026-05-06).
- Tom: confirm trace span naming and add contract test for traces (due 2026-05-06).
- Aisha: draft CS FAQ and runbook edits (due 2026-05-06).

Quick wins (if time):
- Add a small visible tool-tip in UI explaining auto-fallback semantics.
- Add a lightweight smoke lambda that hits /rollouts endpoints to validate contract every deploy.

If anything blocks, call out in thread and tag @eng-leads.

Drafted in a hurry — treat as preflight checklist, not final runbook. Add comments inline in the PR and update this doc.
